title: Plan-02 tail remediation: integration seams broken behind permissive test doubles
description:
Both whole-branch reviewers (2026-08-23) returned NOT READY on dwm-p2r.32's delivered work. Eight Criticals. ROOT CAUSE both reviewers independently identified: throughout the workstream the test doubles were MORE PERMISSIVE (publication ledger fake accepting kinds the real ledger rejects) or MORE CAPABLE (checkpoint fake implementing an idempotency/conflict law production lacks) than the production objects, so green suites certified behavior the shipped graph does not have. The suite is 2039/2042 green and the integration is still broken.

DESKTOP HALF (reviewer A):
A-C1 three of four production publishers cannot talk to the production publication ledger - DesktopPublicationLedger hardcodes KINDS minesweeper_round|shop_purchase|schedule_done and one uniform PUBLICATION_KEYS, but the frozen union is causal_sequence|action_source|board_fate with per-kind shapes; board-fate, shop and round publishers all send frozen kinds/shapes and DesktopActionReceipt has no receipt_id for the binding check. Bootstrap injects the same real ledger into all four. Fails AFTER the admission CAS, in the forward-only region.
A-C2 minesweeper_round departure fails at board-fate commit post-admission: the coordinator builds the departure request from the pre-completion board identity/revision, then commits the action source first, which adopts the NONE/identity-null/revision+1 projection into the shared board state; the fate port then re-checks the prepared pre-state against the changed live board and returns board_fate_conflict. Only the no_departure round path is covered by a real-port test.
A-C3 the consequence checkpoint tier is write-only: nothing in the tree reads desktop-consequence-checkpoint.json, and the stored ordinal-2 stage_candidate is a shape DesktopConsequenceState.validate rejects, so adding a reader would fail. No occupied-slot conflict law exists in the real SaveManagerCheckpointPort even though Task 8's ordinal safety rationale cites that law by name.

PERSISTENCE HALF (reviewer B):
B-C1 the ApplicationMutationGate lease is acquired AFTER the transaction root is issued and the identity allocation is durably committed, inverting the frozen law that requires acquiring new_run/restore BEFORE issuing the root; a busy or fatal-latched gate burns identity and strands the journal record.
B-C2 nothing resumes an incomplete continuation forward - reconcile_startup verifies and returns ok for every non-terminal stage without reacquiring the owner, recomputing the allocation candidate, advancing a stage, or latching fatal.
B-C3 SaveManager documents that a later reconciliation pass finishes a participants_applied operation; no such pass exists.
B-C4 the journal abort/failure half is unreachable from production, so each failed New Run burns an allocation AND appends a permanent unresolvable record - an unbounded durable leak compounding dwm-p2r.33.
B-C5 both sealed evidence documents carry red_green_command_records: [] and a dangling test_log_bindings path; the builder silently skips missing logs, the schema sets no minItems, and no test asserts non-emptiness, so --check reports OK forever.

Full finding text including Importants and Minors is in the SDD ledger at .godot/worktrees/dwm-p2r13-resealed/.superpowers/sdd/progress.md and in this session's review reports. Child beads carry the fix waves.

title: Carry contacts through the Minesweeper round transaction so group activation can commit
description:
Discovered 2026-08-17 while closing dwm-p2r.9 Step 2.5 coverage gaps on branch codex/dwm-p2r13-resealed.

Plan 06 Task 2 Step 2.4 item 7 requires the completion transaction to pass exact before/after round counts to ContactInvitationState so that only a 2->3 transition on Day 2/6 activates the group offer. That cannot happen today, and the cause is structural rather than a missing call.

GameState._SAVE_WHITELIST (autoload/GameState.gd:78-95) does NOT include the 'contacts' section. Consequences, both independently fatal:

1. GameStateMinesweeperPort._detached_clone() rebuilds its clone via reset_game() + apply_save_dict(to_save_dict()). Because to_save_dict() omits contacts, the clone always starts from DEFAULT contacts, so prepare_activate_group_after_round()'s 'both pair solos unread and AVAILABLE' predicate fails with missing_solo and never activates.
2. The port's candidate is exactly clone.to_save_dict(), which also omits contacts, so even a successful activation could never reach the committed candidate.

Verified empirically by probe on 2026-08-17: 'to_save_dict has contacts? false', 'candidate has contacts? false', receipt.group_activation_transaction_id = null, live group_action state after prepare = INACTIVE.

Therefore the hardcoded receipt values group_activation_transaction_id=null and message_transaction_ids=[] in GameStateMinesweeperPort.prepare_complete are TRUTHFUL for the current candidate surface. This is not a receipt-reporting bug; do not 'fix' it by populating those fields while contacts remain outside the transaction, or the receipt will claim a state change that was never committed.

Note that GameState._bridge_maybe_activate_group() (autoload/GameState.gd:750-763) IS correctly implemented and DOES activate on the live object with transaction id 'gactivate:day<N>'. Only the Minesweeper round transaction path cannot reach it.

dwm-p2r.9 deliberately closed without this. The plan's own rule is that only fake ports exercise this transport in .9, and the coordinator/dating contract coverage added on 2026-08-17 (139/139 gate) stands independently.
design: Widen the Minesweeper round transaction's candidate/commit/rollback surface to carry the contacts section alongside gameplay, mirroring how capture_live_run_state() and capture_restore_backup() already treat contacts as a sibling section. Then populate CompletionReceipt.group_activation_transaction_id and message_transaction_ids from the transactions the domain actually recorded, by diffing contacts.transaction_receipts on the clone and classifying new entries by their 'kind' field ('activate_group' vs 'offer_solo') rather than re-deriving the activation rule in the port. Changing the committed candidate shape touches RunSnapshotSchema and the save/restore path, so expect migration and snapshot-validation work; it also invalidates evidence/phase_2r/handoff/minesweeper_contract.json and requires regenerating both handoff artifacts and their seven-record ledger.
acceptance_criteria: Completing the third app round on an eligible Day 2 (and Day 6) commits group_action state AVAILABLE_UNOPENED with a null inviter_id and history_generated=false, and the CompletionReceipt reports the matching gactivate transaction id. Transitions 1->2 and 3->4, non-window days, and ineligible or already-read solo offers all commit no activation and report null. Dating rounds never activate the group under any transition. Both handoff artifacts and the command ledger are regenerated and validate clean.

title: Dating rounds cannot begin during the deferred-pair presentation (stage-level route, no substage)
description: FOUND BY the dwm-p2r.23 fresh-context review, 2026-08-21, verified in source at 32416d7f4. A dating-context Minesweeper round attempted during the deferred-pair presentation therefore still fails DATING_ROUTE_NOT_ACTIVE - the same unbeginnable-round bug dwm-p2r.23 fixed, one door over. WHETHER IT MATTERS depends on design intent: if the deferred pair presentation can host boards (its timeline id is dating.twofriends...pre_challenge, which suggests it can), the resolver needs a stage-level branch deriving evidence from the deferred pair entry (the committed group entry Hospital superseded, participants priscilla+lavinia); if pair presentations never host boards, that must be recorded deliberately. ACCEPTANCE: decide with the design authority; if boards are hosted, RED first over the real port with a deferred-pair pause (the matrix suite's group-seed machinery reaches it); either way the resolver's docstring states which presentations can begin rounds.

title: presentation_stage_receipt mints required-true Hospital evidence for a Hospital that never presented
description: FOUND BY the dwm-p2r.28 fresh-context review, 2026-08-20, verified in source at 678fdc23f. The dwm-p2r.28 stage allowlist keeps hospital_if_triggered answerable at the presentation settle seam, but a Hospital that NEVER presented (required=false - its site was empty and it completed immediately, or it is still pending/active under a port-direct walk) is still allowlisted, and the seam's envelope constructor _hospital_envelope(presented=true) sets required := presented, so a direct caller handing such a Hospital's transaction receives an envelope claiming required=true with freshly recomputed superseded_entry_ids. WHY IT CAN PERSIST: RunLifecycle._validate_owner_receipt special-cases only invitation_rollover / increment_day / resolve_ending_plan / enter_ending - Hospital is shape-only downstream - and production prepare_completion blocks different-bytes only for COMPLETED records, so for an ACTIVE required=false Hospital stage the minted evidence can be durably persisted via prepare/commit with no check anywhere on the path. Durable false evidence: the stage-level analog of the right-kind-wrong-state hole dwm-p2r.27 sealed one level down. OPEN QUESTION the review says deserves investigation rather than a closing assertion: the presentation intent child is derived through the retained issuer while the stage is still PENDING, so the issuer's derivation log may constitute a durable required-marker the gate could read without the forbidden completion-time live-state re-read (the FINDING-4 bug class). ACCEPTANCE: RED first over the real port; either the seam refuses (or answers required-truthfully from durable evidence) for a Hospital that never presented, or the limit is proven and pinned deliberately.

title: prepare_completion declares a STAGE duplicate without comparing bytes, masking the conflict for stages
description: FOUND BY the dwm-p2r.22 fresh-context review, 2026-08-20, verified in source. GameStateDayResolutionPort.prepare_completion's stage branch (scripts/application/run/GameStateDayResolutionPort.gd:431-436) declares a duplicate on transaction id + completed state alone, with NO byte comparison against stage[receipt]. A completed STAGE replayed with DIFFERENT bytes therefore returns a benign duplicate carrying the stored receipt, and the domain's duplicate_transaction_conflict (DayResolutionPlan._complete_record:529) is unreachable for stages through this port. After the dwm-p2r.22 fix, SUBSTAGES are stricter than stages: the substage descent gates on _plan_receipt_from_envelope(receipt) == substage[receipt] and lets a mismatch fall through to the domain conflict. No test pins the stage-tamper case in either direction - the dwm-p2r.22 mutation set observed that adding or removing a stage-branch byte gate leaves every suite green. The fake mirrors the asymmetry deliberately (FakeDayResolutionStatePort.prepare_completion), so fixing production means fixing the fake in the same change. ACCEPTANCE: decide the stage-tamper contract deliberately (most likely: mismatch falls through to the domain conflict, mirroring substages), RED first pinning current masking, fix port + fake together, and note that this alters complete_route_stage's observable contract for tampered stage replays.
close_reason: Fixed at a68e3b54f. The stage branch of prepare_completion now short-circuits duplicate only for byte-identical replays via _plan_receipt_from_envelope; different bytes fall through to the domain conflict, restoring symmetry with the dwm-p2r.22 substage gate. Fake mirrored with prepare-time conflict; both stale asymmetry comments rewritten; one existing coordinator test repaired to store the folded envelope production actually persists (the review's scope catch). Two REDs observed first, six mutations observed and reverted (two expected-all-green, meanings recorded), five gates green with every delta accounted for. Full record in the final comment.
